identificationModule.briefTitle: Preoperative Systemic Therapy for Colorectal Cancer Peritoneal Metastases
identificationModule.officialTitle: Preoperative Systemic Therapy With FOLFOXIRI Plus Bevacizumab Followed by Cytoreductive Surgery Versus Upfront Cytoreductive Surgery for Resectable Colorectal Peritoneal Metastases: A Randomized Phase 2 Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, parallel-group, phase 2 randomized trial which randomizes patients with isolated resectable colorectal cancer peritoneal metastases to receive preoperative systematic therapy followed by CRS+HIPEC and postoperative chemotherapy or upfront CRS+HIPEC followed by postoperative chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: Chemotherapy group
armGroups.description: 6 cycles of mFOLFOXIRI±Bev is followed by cytoreductive surgery. Postoperative 6 cycles of mFOLFOX is scheduled.

armGroups.label: Upfront surgery group
armGroups.description: Upfront surgery group is followed by 12 cycles of mFOLFOX+Bev

interventions.name: Preoperative systematic therapy
interventions.description: 6 cycles of mFOLFOXIRI±Bev is administrated before CRS+HIPEC. Irinotecan165mg/m2 IV day 1, oxaliplatin 85mg/m2 IV day 1, leucovorin 400mg/m2 IV day , bevacizumab mg/kg IV day 1, 5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2, continuous infusion over 46-48h. Dose reduction is permitted. Bev will not be administrated in at the last two cycles for minimizing surgery complications.

interventions.name: CRS+HIPEC
interventions.description: CRS+HIPEC aims to achieve CC0/CC1 resection. Oxaliplatin or mitomycin C is determined by the treating physician.

interventions.name: Postoperative chemotherapy
interventions.description: 6 cycles of mFOLFOX+Bev is administrated after CRS+HIPEC. Oxaliplatin 85mg/m2 IV day 1, leucovorin 400mg/m2 IV day , bevacizumab mg/kg IV day 1, 5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2 IV bolus day 1,5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2, continuous infusion over 46-48h. Dose reduction is permitted.

interventions.name: Postoperative chemotherapy
interventions.description: 12 cycles of mFOLFOX+Bev is administrated after CRS+HIPEC. Oxaliplatin 85mg/m2 IV day 1, leucovorin 400mg/m2 IV day , bevacizumab mg/kg IV day 1, 5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2 IV bolus day 1,5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2, continuous infusion over 46-48h. Dose reduction is permitted.

primaryOutcomes.description: From randomization to progression by RECIST1.1, or appearance of measurable lesion after non-measureable lesion, or intraoperative unresectable disease, or recurrence after surgery, or death from any reason.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to five years after randomization

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Major adverse events of systematic therapy

secondaryOutcomes.description: From randomization to death of any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to five years after randomization

secondaryOutcomes.description: Peritoneal cancer index (PCI) is a tool which sum scores in thirteen abdominal regions according to tumor size.
